test.create_query: CREATE TABLE gbl_minmax (v UInt64, k UInt64, low UInt8, INDEX k_mm k TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, INDEX low_mm low TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY v SETTINGS add_minmax_index_for_numeric_columns = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO gbl_minmax SELECT number, intHash32(intDiv(number, 8192)) * 1000 + number % 1000, number % 3 FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
test.query: SELECT UserID, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID LIMIT 10 SETTINGS enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic}
SELECT UserID, SearchPhrase, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID, SearchPhrase LIMIT 10 SETTINGS enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic}
SELECT UserID, extract(minute FROM EventTime) AS m, SearchPhrase, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID, m, SearchPhrase LIMIT 10 SETTINGS enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic}
SELECT UserID, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY UserID LIMIT 10 SETTINGS enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic}
SELECT CounterID, count() FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY CounterID DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic}
SELECT k, count() FROM gbl_minmax GROUP BY k LIMIT 10
SELECT low, count() FROM gbl_minmax GROUP BY low LIMIT 3
